#### Where the Lempel--Ziv code comes from

@cover2006elements [section 13.4] describe the incremental parsing of @def-lempel-ziv-parsing,
and a second form of the code that points back into the message instead.
The code needs no knowledge of the probabilities,
yet @thm-lempel-ziv-optimality shows that it still reaches the entropy.

:::
